judge.reason: The plan is built from vertical slices with checkable deciding checks and explicit dependencies. S1 is an end-to-end refund that writes the audit row in the same transaction and verifies a 403 for unpermitted users. Later slices add over-refund and concurrency tests, append-only grants, and a fault-injection idempotency test. The provider unknown is a 1-day spike (R0a) with explicit questions, including whether the refund call accepts an idempotency key, and it requires observed sandbox behavior rather than docs; the answer makes no fabricated claims and is honest that the workspace was empty.
